item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Various Artists - BETX Fan Fest @ LA Convention Center 2025-06-07 (audience recording)
item.description:
https://pixeldrain.com/l/FsCxQRyK


Finally worked thru Day #1 and figured out who I saw. Love going to these even if it's just a 1 man party to me.

Actually saw The Residents do a daytime show at the Mayan for some festival, walked over to this, then staggered back to the festival afterparty at Clifton's where I saw some band I am trying to figure out. HAF and completely oblivious to the protests and riots happening just blocks away until my mom texted and said "Is LA under martial law?"

Just got started on Day #2

There's always the chance some of these might be recorded with internals but there ain't gonna be 27 sources to differentiate from and possibly not a single person alive will ever hear any of this ever again. Some may or may not be complete. Amerie was playing as I walked in. But I was walking in and out for toke breaks all day. In and out thru the EVolv scanners with a fully wired rig.

In 2024 I noted the venue as West Hall. In 2025 I really had no idea where I was and at least I had a friend to help me find my way home day #2. That was still a one man party only with a babysitter.
